datasets.name: DepositInfo
datasets.sql:
select cust.name,
       sbcm_stored_programs.SbcmOpenDate(Cont.ID) as opendate,
       sbcm_stored_programs.SBCMGetOldDate(Cont.ID) as closedate,
       sbcm_stored_programs.GetpercentCollection(Cont.ID) as annualInt,
       sbcm_stored_programs.getoverduepercent(Cont.ID) As OverDueAnnualInt,
       -- sbcm_stored_programs.GetOverduePercentType(Cont.ID) As OverDueAnnualInt,
        sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccount(Acc.ContractAccID) as ContractAccNo,
      sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccount(Acc.ClientAccID) as ClientAccNo,
      sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccount(Acc.InterestAccID) as InterestAccNo,
      cstate.FACTICALDEBT,
      cstate.FACTICALINTERESTDEBT
from sbcm_contracts cont,
     sbcm_contract_accounts acc,
     sbcm_contract_state cstate,
customers cust
where 
Cont.ID = :ContractID and
cust.id = Cont.customerID and
acc.id# = :ContractID and
cstate.id# = :ContractID

datasets.name: DepositAccno
datasets.sql:
select ac.id,ac.acc_no,av.VAL_NAME from account ac,
                                  sbcm_categories sc,
                                  sbcm_movie_names sm,
                                  sbcm_settings ss,
                                  sbcm_contracts sb,
                                  avalute av where 
 
sb.ID        =:ContractID             and
ss.CURRENCYID=sb.CURRENCY             and
sc.id        =sm.TYPEID               and
sm.NAME      ='outComeAccForDeposit'  and
sm.id        =ss.PARENTID             and
ac.id        =ss.ACCID                and
ac.VAL_ACC   =av.VALUTE               and
sc.id        =sb.CLIENTTYPE
